title: Cosmic Maternity Portal
description: Three women with long dark hair in matching black crop tops, blue shorts, and high heels stand together taking a selfie in front of a large oval cosmic portal. The portal features swirling purple and blue galaxies with dripping glittery edges, set against a starry space background with pink satin fabric and pillows in the foreground.
prompt: Three pregnant women with long dark ponytails wearing black crop tops, shiny blue shorts and purple high heels stand posing and taking a selfie together, positioned in front of a large ornate oval portal showing a swirling purple blue galaxy with stars and nebulae, the portal has a glittery turquoise frame with dripping icing-like details, set in a dark starry space background with strings of purple lights, foreground features flowing shiny pink satin fabric with pillows and small decorative elements, vibrant colorful surreal scene
